arabic_html:
وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ
وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ
قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدْرًا ۞
translit:
Wa yarzuqhu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasib.
Wa man yatawakkal ʿala-llāhi fa-huwa ḥasbuh.
Inna-llāha bālighu amrih · qad jaʿala-llāhu li-kulli shayʾin qadrā.

translation: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a decreed extent.
translation_vo: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah. then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a decreed extent.
explanation_html: The word is ḥasbuh — enough for him. Whoever truly relies on Allah, Ibn Kathīr says, Allah suffices him — and provides from where he never expected. Then the verse closes: Allah always accomplishes His purpose.
explanation_vo: The word here is hasbuh. Enough for him. Whoever truly relies on Allah, Ibn Kathir explains, Allah suffices him, and provides from where he never expected. Then the verse closes: Allah always accomplishes His purpose.
